use_cases: Hero section headlines with premium shimmer effect to capture attention
Feature highlight text with animated gradient for visual emphasis
Logo or brand name displays with luxury animation feel
Call-to-action buttons with shimmer effect to increase engagement
Loading state text with continuous animation
ai_summary: A text shimmer effect component that animates a gradient sweep across text content using CSS background-position animation. Supports dark mode and configurable duration/spread parameters. Commonly used in hero sections, feature highlights, and premium brand displays to create a polished, dynamic visual experience.
